newsitem.title: GERMANY: German call money rates slip to 2.95/3.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: German call money rates slip to 2.95/3.00 pct.

text.p: German call money rates eased to 2.95/3.00 percent on Tuesday from 2.97/3.02 percent on Monday afternoon as cash levels in the market rose.

Commercial banks' effective deposits at the Bundesbank rose to 40.7 billion marks on Monday from Tuesday's 40.2 billion while the average for the month through Monday rose to 40.3 billion marks from 40.2 billion.
Bank borrowing from the 4.50 percent Lombard facility was about 200 million marks on Monday after making negligible use of the facility in recent days.
The Frankfurt Interbank Overnight Average was 3.01733 on Tuesday compared with 3.01400 percent on Monday.
